lines.zh: 恐惧之植不会走，只能伸展
lines.en: Terrorflora cannot walk; it only reaches.

lines.zh: 它的藤蔓在地面缓缓爬开
lines.en: Its vines crawl slowly over the ground.
A bough leans a little nearer.

lines.zh: 根须从土里拱起又落下
lines.en: Roots lift out of the soil and settle.

lines.zh: 它的藤条拖过地面，沙沙响
lines.en: Vines drag over the ground, rasping.

lines.zh: 它把整片身体朝你挪了半寸
lines.en: Its whole mass shifts an inch your way.

lines.zh: 藤蔓像蛇一样分开再合拢
lines.en: The vines part and close like snakes.

lines.zh: 它的枝叶在动，却不是风
lines.en: Its leaves move, and it is not the wind.
Tendrils probe across the dirt.

lines.zh: 它的根把石头顶得挪了位
lines.en: Its roots shift a stone aside.

lines.zh: 恐惧之植静静立着，很高
lines.en: Terrorflora stands quiet and very tall.
Its bracts open and close slowly.
Vines hang down, tips swaying.
A low hum comes from its trunk.

lines.zh: 花瓣边缘渗出一点黏液
lines.en: Slime beads along the petal edges.

lines.zh: 它把一片叶子转过来朝光
lines.en: It turns a leaf into the light.
Roots stir gently in the soil.
Its heart opens for an instant.
Then slowly closes again.

lines.zh: 一只虫子落在它身上，被吞了
lines.en: An insect lands on it and is absorbed.

lines.zh: 空气在它周围变得潮湿
lines.en: The air around it turns damp.

lines.zh: 它的颜色像烂掉的果子
lines.en: Its colour is that of rotting fruit.

lines.zh: 藤蔓彼此摩擦，发出干响
lines.en: Vines rub together with a dry sound.

lines.zh: 它的影子遮住了一大片土
lines.en: Its shadow covers a wide patch of soil.
It seems always to be breathing.
That breath smells sweet and rotten.
Terrorflora turns slowly toward you.

lines.zh: 它的花心正对着你的方向
lines.en: Its heart points your way.
The vines halt in front of you.

lines.zh: 它把你从头到脚看了一遍
lines.en: It takes you in from head to foot.
The bracts open, showing what is inside.
It is all fine spines.
A root swells by your feet.
A leaf reaches to your face.
Slime hangs from the leaf's edge.
It is judging whether you are big enough.

lines.zh: 藤蔓慢慢绕到你的侧面
lines.en: A vine works around your flank.
It looks not the least hurried.

lines.zh: 恐惧之植晃了一下，叶子落了几片
lines.en: Terrorflora sways; a few leaves fall.

lines.zh: 它把受伤的藤蔓缩了回去
lines.en: It draws the hurt vine back.
Its hum changes pitch.
Thick sap seeps from the break.
It makes no cry; it only goes quieter.
Roots stir quickly in the soil.
Its bracts close for a moment.
A new shoot pushes from the wound.

lines.zh: 它把整株身体压低半寸
lines.en: Its whole mass sinks an inch.

lines.zh: 然后它重新把花心对着你
lines.en: Then it aims its heart at you again.

lines.zh: 恐惧之植朝你手上的东西倾
lines.en: Terrorflora leans toward what you hold.
A vine reaches out and touches it.
It coils around it and draws it back.
The bracts close and swallow it.

lines.zh: 里面传来轻微的挤压声
lines.en: A soft pressing sound comes from inside.
It seems to want more.
The vines come out again.
This time they reach further.

lines.zh: 它的花心里滴下一点黏液
lines.en: Slime drips from its heart.

lines.zh: 它把卷须朝你的手举起来
lines.en: A tendril lifts toward your hand.

lines.zh: 你撞上它的藤蔓，被弹开
lines.en: You hit a vine and are pushed back.
Its bough is hard as stone.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀陷进一片软叶里
lines.en: Your shoulder sinks into a soft leaf.

lines.zh: 它没有退，只是缓缓让开
lines.en: It does not yield, only slides aside.
A root humps up under your feet.
A root trips you into a stagger.
A vine takes the chance to wrap your foot.
It draws you toward itself.

lines.zh: 它的身体像墙一样压过来
lines.en: Its bulk presses in like a wall.
The impact does nothing to it.

lines.zh: 两株巨植把藤蔓缠在一起
lines.en: Two giant plants twine their vines.
Their hearts face one another.

lines.zh: 苞叶一张一合，节奏相同
lines.en: Their bracts pulse in the same rhythm.
The sweet rot in the air thickens.

lines.zh: 它们的根在土下连成一片
lines.en: Their roots join beneath the soil.
The vines weave into a net.

lines.zh: 它们同时垂下所有叶子
lines.en: Both let every leaf droop.
Their hearts slowly close.

lines.zh: 周围的地面变得很安静
lines.en: The ground around goes very quiet.

lines.zh: 这片荒地从此只属于它们
lines.en: This waste now belongs to them alone.
A vine coils the item and hauls it back.
It brings the item to its heart.
The bracts fold it in to digest.

lines.zh: 它把没用的东西吐出来
lines.en: What it cannot use, it spits out.

lines.zh: 它把东西塞进根的缝里
lines.en: It stuffs the item into a root gap.
A tendril reaches for another.
It presses the item into the soil.
Its motion is slow but certain.

lines.zh: 它把食物分给旁边的芽
lines.en: It passes food to a shoot beside it.
Then it settles back to waiting.

lines.zh: 恐惧之植把整个身体转过来
lines.en: Terrorflora turns its whole mass.
Its vines rise all at once.
A dull tremor runs through the ground.
Roots break surface on every side.
The bracts open to full width.
Its heart opens like a mouth.
Slime runs from the leaf edges.
The vines close a ring around you.
The air turns close and heavy.

lines.zh: 它的低鸣变成了一声长响
lines.en: Its hum stretches into a long note.
Roots shove gravel aside.
Its tallest bough bends toward you.
The soil shifts under your feet.

lines.zh: 它的影子把整片地吞掉
lines.en: Its shadow swallows the whole ground.
Every spine stands up.

lines.zh: 它已经把你围进了中心
lines.en: You are already inside its circle.

lines.zh: 藤蔓不再摇晃，绷得很直
lines.en: The vines stop swaying and pull straight.

lines.zh: 它开始动了，很慢，但很快
lines.en: It starts to move: slowly, and swiftly.

lines.zh: 恐惧之植一点一点压过来
lines.en: Terrorflora presses in by degrees.

lines.zh: 藤蔓在你两侧慢慢抬高
lines.en: Vines rise slowly on either side.
Roots close behind you.
It is tightening the ring.
A bract hangs above your head.
Slime hits the ground with a hiss.
Its heart keeps aimed at you.
You step back; the vines follow.

lines.zh: 藤蔓从土里又冒出一圈
lines.en: Another ring of vines breaks the soil.
Its hum sets your ears ringing.
It is in no hurry to close.
It waits for you to panic.
A vine slips behind your legs.
You hear roots shifting in the soil.
Its trunk leans slightly forward.
The spines in its heart draw in.
Sweet rot fills the air.
It has sealed every exit.

lines.zh: 留给你落脚的地方越来越窄
lines.en: The ground left to stand on narrows.
It could close at any moment.
A vine whips across your back.
A vine wraps your leg and cinches.
A bough sweeps through.
A bract shuts on your shoulder.
Spines rake across your armour.
It drags you toward its heart.
Slime hits your hand and burns.
A root buckles up under you.
One lash, then another.
The vines move like whips.

lines.zh: 它用整枝把你压倒在地
lines.en: A whole bough bears you down.

lines.zh: 刺在你袖子上划开一道
lines.en: Spines open a line in your sleeve.
It pulls back half a foot and comes down again.
Slow, but it lands where it means to.

lines.zh: 荒地的土面鼓起一大块
lines.en: A great mound swells in the waste.

lines.zh: 恐惧之植从土里顶出来
lines.en: Terrorflora pushes up out of the ground.

lines.zh: 土石从它的枝叶上滚落
lines.en: Earth and stone slide off its limbs.
Its vines unfold one by one.
Roots drive in and anchor it.
Its trunk rises section by section.
The bracts open slowly.

lines.zh: 一朵巨大的花心露了出来
lines.en: A vast heart is revealed.
The smell of sweet rot spreads.

lines.zh: 地上的小虫全都爬走了
lines.en: Every small creature on the ground flees.

lines.zh: 它的影子罩住半片荒地
lines.en: Its shadow covers half the waste.

lines.zh: 风把它的叶子吹得直响
lines.en: The wind rattles its leaves.

lines.zh: 它没有眼睛，却知道你在哪
lines.en: It has no eyes, yet knows where you are.

lines.zh: 它的低鸣从土里传上来
lines.en: Its hum comes up through the soil.
Gravel is crushed between its roots.

lines.zh: 它的枝条伸向四个方向
lines.en: Its boughs reach out four ways.

lines.zh: 地面上再没有别的声音
lines.en: No other sound remains on the ground.
It has settled into place.
Then it turns its heart toward you.

lines.zh: 荒地上多了一座活的塔
lines.en: The waste has gained a living tower.

lines.zh: 叶子被点着，它抖落一片火
lines.en: Leaves catch and it sheds a sheet of flame.

lines.zh: 从高处砸落，它的枝干折了几根
lines.en: Dropped from height, several boughs snap.

lines.zh: 水漫过根部，它开始发软
lines.en: Water covers its roots and it softens.
The blast strips half its foliage.

lines.zh: 箭扎进它的躯干，只进去一半
lines.en: An arrow sinks halfway into its trunk.

lines.zh: 怪力让它所有藤蔓一起抽动
lines.en: Odd force sets every vine jerking.

lines.zh: 缺少养分，它的颜色发灰
lines.en: Unfed, its colour turns grey.
Lightning runs down through its boughs.

lines.zh: 虚空扯住根须，它被往上拔
lines.en: The void pulls its roots and it lifts.
